name: Dan
line: Dan was a city in the far north of Israel, once called Laish, that the tribe of Dan took and named; it became known for idol worship.

moments.title: Abram chases the raiders
moments.text: When Abram heard that Lot had been captured, he took 318 trained men from his household and chased the enemy as far as Dan.

moments.title: The Danites take Laish
moments.text: The tribe of Dan attacked the quiet people of Laish, burned the city, rebuilt it, and named it Dan. They set up idols there.

moments.title: Jeroboam's golden calf
moments.text: King Jeroboam set up one golden calf in Dan and another in Bethel. The people walked all the way to Dan to worship the calf, and this became a sin.

moments.title: Ben-hadad conquers Dan
moments.text: King Asa sent silver and gold to Ben-hadad of Aram. Ben-hadad then sent his army against Israel and conquered Dan and other cities.

moments.title: Horses heard from Dan
moments.text: Jeremiah warned that the snorting of enemy horses was heard from Dan. The whole land shook as the enemy came to devour it.
